$comment: SHA-256 of each pinned Gitleaks release archive, tracked in this repository so a scan verifies the download against a reviewed digest and not only against a checksum file served from the same place as the archive. Keys are <platform>_<architecture> as GitleaksBinaryResolver composes them. Update together with PinnedVersion; the upstream source is gitleaks_<version>_checksums.txt on the release page.
